name: Pacific madrone
desc: Pacific madrone (Arbutus menziesii): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 369 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Arbutus menziesii, or Pacific madrone, is a species of broadleaf evergreen tree in the family Ericaceae. It has waxy foliage, a contorted growth habit, and flaky bark.
